title: 2022 Shelby GT500 Heritage Edition

scenes.headline: Most Powerful Mustang
scenes.narration: The 2022 Shelby GT500 Heritage Edition is the most powerful factory Mustang ever built. Those classic white racing stripes aren't just for looks; they scream American muscle.

scenes.headline: Classic Performance
scenes.narration: The dual racing stripes across the hood reflect a nod to its illustrious racing past. The GT500 badge stands for decades of track dominance.

scenes.headline: 760 HP & 625 lb-ft
scenes.narration: Under the hood, the supercharged 5.2-liter V8 cranks out 760 horsepower and 625 pound-feet of torque. The Shelby snake emblem on the intake declares its raw power.

scenes.headline: Aerodynamics Enhanced
scenes.narration: The GT500's rear spoiler isn’t just for show. It improves aerodynamics, anchoring the car with aggressive styling that means business.

scenes.headline: Adjustable Rear Wing
scenes.narration: The adjustable rear wing is a hallmark of the Shelby GT500. Tailor your aerodynamic setup for street or track.

scenes.headline: Recaro Performance
scenes.narration: Inside, the Recaro racing seats are embroidered with the Shelby logo, underlining the GT500's status as a true driver's car.

scenes.headline: Carbon Fiber Accents
scenes.narration: The interior boasts carbon fiber accents on the dashboard and console, emphasizing performance-inspired design and saving weight.

scenes.headline: $73K MSRP
scenes.narration: The GT500 started around $73,000 new, and it’s holding value strong, a testament to its coveted status among muscle car enthusiasts, only dropping about 10% annually.

scenes.headline: Vs Camaro ZL1
scenes.narration: When pitted against the Camaro ZL1, the GT500's 760 hp trumps the ZL1's 650 hp. A clear powerhouse, with bragging rights to match.

scenes.headline: Choose Your Power
scenes.narration: So, does the Shelby GT500’s raw power and heritage make it your ultimate muscle car?

script: The 2022 Shelby GT500 Heritage Edition is the most powerful factory Mustang ever built. Those classic white racing stripes aren't just for looks; they scream American muscle. The dual racing stripes across the hood reflect a nod to its illustrious racing past. The GT500 badge stands for decades of track dominance. Under the hood, the supercharged 5.2-liter V8 cranks out 760 horsepower and 625 pound-feet of torque. The Shelby snake emblem on the intake declares its raw power. The GT500's rear spoiler isn’t just for show. It improves aerodynamics, anchoring the car with aggressive styling that means business. The adjustable rear wing is a hallmark of the Shelby GT500. Tailor your aerodynamic setup for street or track. Inside, the Recaro racing seats are embroidered with the Shelby logo, underlining the GT500's status as a true driver's car. The interior boasts carbon fiber accents on the dashboard and console, emphasizing performance-inspired design and saving weight. The GT500 started around $73,000 new, and it’s holding value strong, a testament to its coveted status among muscle car enthusiasts, only dropping about 10% annually. When pitted against the Camaro ZL1, the GT500's 760 hp trumps the ZL1's 650 hp. A clear powerhouse, with bragging rights to match. So, does the Shelby GT500’s raw power and heritage make it your ultimate muscle car?
